Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vero Medallion Wool Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Neutral Multi
Materials: wool
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Stunning dark green and blue medallions highlighted by a cream background and tassled ends create a sophisticated look. This runner is ideal for freshening up any transitional or contemporary room that needs a punch of elegant color and pattern. 2'6" x 8' Hand-tufted in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
